title: Correct magnetic induction
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (1) must be 0.4 T (or equivalent).

title: Correct formula application
description: Important: The student must correctly apply the formula F = BIL for a perpendicular wire to relate force, current, length, and field.

title: Unit consistency
description: Important: The calculation must correctly convert the wire length to meters (0.2 m) to obtain the correct tesla value.

title: Independence of B
description: Essential: For part (2), the student must state that the magnetic induction (B) does not change when the current increases.

title: Correct reasoning for independence
description: Important: The explanation must correctly state that B is a property of the magnetic field source, not dependent on the current in the test wire.

title: Confusing B with force
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly states that B changes because the force changes, confusing cause and effect.

title: Unit omission or error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the final answer for B lacks the correct unit (T) or uses an incorrect unit without correction.
